constraints: Must be called from within an event-handling project method installed via ON EVENT CALL.

WARNING: an event-handling method that only calls FILTER EVENT causes 4D to ignore all events for that process (use Ctrl+Shift+Backspace / Cmd-Opt-Shift-Ctrl-Backspace to convert it back to a normal, non-event-receiving process).

Can also be used inside a standard output form method (displayed via DISPLAY SELECTION/MODIFY SELECTION) specifically to filter double-clicks on records, guarded by checking Form event code = On Double Clicked.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Consumes the current event so it is not passed on to 4D's default handling, when called from an ON EVENT CALL event-handling method.
